title: [LOGGED IN] Home "Clan reward" opens a Clan reward section when logged in
reason: Header 'Clan reward' (href /store/) opened the top of the Store page; no Clan reward section anywhere on the page

steps.text: Start a new browser session with no saved cookies. Open https://site.ludus-game.com/?user-id=12580628 in the browser and wait until the page has finished loading.
steps.saw: Home loaded at https://site.ludus-game.com/; cookie banner and 'Login successful' popup shown

steps.text: If a "How we use cookies" banner is shown, click "Dismiss". If any other popup is shown after login, close it. Do not click the "Player12580628" button: it logs out.
steps.saw: Clicked Dismiss on the cookie banner, then 'Ok' on the 'Login successful' popup

steps.text: Does the header show a green "Player12580628" button and no "Login" button?
steps.saw: Header button 'Player12580628' with green gradient rgb(12,150,87)->rgb(118,211,71); 0 visible 'Login' buttons
Clicked header link 'Clan reward' (href https://site.ludus-game.com/store/, target _self); navigated to https://site.ludus-game.com/store/
Waited 3 s; still at https://site.ludus-game.com/store/, scrollY 0, no #hash

steps.text: Is a section about the clan reward (with its rewards or a Claim button) visible on screen?
steps.saw: Screen shows the top of the Store page ('LUDUS - Official Webshop' and the 'Special offer' USD 54.00 banner). The Store page has no Clan reward section at all: headings are Special offers, Store, Free wares, Might Passes, Gold, Rewards Market, Loyalty Shop, FAQ; no text containing 'clan' found. The Store header menu also has no 'Clan reward' item.
